topic: 機車 / 火車 / 客運
can_do_en: I can choose between scooter, train and intercity bus, ask how long a trip takes and how far a place is, and ask station staff about the next train.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 阿傑，我明天想去高雄。坐火車還是騎機車比較好？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄚ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄑㄩˋ ㄍㄠ ㄒㄩㄥˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄏㄞˊ ㄕˋ ㄑㄧˊ ㄐㄧ ㄔㄜ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄠˇ
dialogue.en: Ajie, I'd like to go to Kaohsiung tomorrow. Is it better to take the train or ride a scooter?

dialogue.speaker: 阿傑
dialogue.zh: 坐火車比較好啦。騎機車比坐火車慢，週末路上車也很多。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄠˇ ˙ㄌㄚ ㄑㄧˊ ㄐㄧ ㄔㄜ ㄅㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄇㄢˋ ㄓㄡ ㄇㄛˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄔㄜ ㄧㄝˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ
dialogue.en: The train's better. A scooter is slower than the train, and there's a lot of traffic on the roads at the weekend, too.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 從屏東到高雄，坐火車要多久？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄨㄥ ㄉㄠˋ ㄍㄠ ㄒㄩㄥˊ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄐㄧㄡˇ
dialogue.en: How long does the train take from Pingtung to Kaohsiung?

dialogue.speaker: 阿傑
dialogue.zh: 差不多半個小時。車站離我家不遠，我騎機車載你去。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄔㄚ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄅㄢˋ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄕˊ ㄔㄜ ㄓㄢˋ ㄌㄧˊ ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄅㄨˋ ㄩㄢˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄑㄧˊ ㄐㄧ ㄔㄜ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄑㄩˋ
dialogue.en: About half an hour. The station isn't far from my place; I'll take you there on my scooter.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那我需要先買票嗎？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄞˋ ㄏㄠˇ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄋㄚˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄇㄞˇ ㄆㄧㄠˋ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: Great! So do I need to buy a ticket first?

dialogue.speaker: 阿傑
dialogue.zh: 不用啦，刷悠遊卡就可以進站了。明天記得帶喔！
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄩㄥˋ ˙ㄌㄚ ㄕㄨㄚ ㄧㄡ ㄧㄡˊ ㄎㄚˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄓㄢˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄐㄧˋ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄉㄞˋ ㄛ
dialogue.en: No need. Just tap your EasyCard and you can go in. Remember to bring it tomorrow!

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 好。對了，下個星期我想去墾丁，也可以坐火車嗎？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄑㄧˊ ㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄑㄩˋ ㄎㄣˇ ㄉㄧㄥ ㄧㄝˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: OK. Oh, and next week I'd like to go to Kenting. Can I take the train there too?

dialogue.speaker: 阿傑
dialogue.zh: 墾丁沒有火車喔，要坐客運。客運比較慢，要兩三個小時。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄎㄣˇ ㄉㄧㄥ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄛ ㄧㄠˋ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄩㄣˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄩㄣˋ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄇㄢˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄙㄢ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄕˊ
dialogue.en: There's no train to Kenting, you know. You have to take the intercity bus. The bus is slower: it takes two or three hours.

dialogue.speaker: 阿傑
dialogue.zh: 到了！安全帽給我，你快去吧。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄉㄠˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄇㄠˋ ㄍㄟˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄋㄧˇ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄑㄩˋ ˙ㄅㄚ
dialogue.en: (The next morning, at Pingtung Station) Here we are! Give me the helmet, and off you go.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 請問，下一班去高雄的火車幾點開？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄧ ㄅㄢ ㄑㄩˋ ㄍㄠ ㄒㄩㄥˊ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄎㄞ
dialogue.en: Excuse me, what time does the next train to Kaohsiung leave?

dialogue.speaker: 站務員
dialogue.zh: 十點十五分，在第二月台。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄕˊ ㄨˇ ㄈㄣ ㄗㄞˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄦˋ ㄩㄝˋ ㄊㄞˊ

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄕㄨㄚ ㄎㄚˇ
dialogue.en: Where do I tap my card?

dialogue.speaker: 站務員
dialogue.zh: 就在前面。你看，大家都在那邊刷卡。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄎㄢˋ ㄉㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄉㄡ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˋ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄕㄨㄚ ㄎㄚˇ
dialogue.en: Just up ahead. Look, everyone's tapping their cards over there.

vocab.en: from (distance: A 離 B 很近)
to tap or swipe a card
measure word for scheduled runs (下一班 'the next one')

grammar.note_en: 從屏東到高雄 marks where the trip starts and ends; the question about the trip (坐火車要多久？) follows it.
騎機車比坐火車慢 compares two ways of getting there: A 比 B + adjective, with no 很 before the adjective.
車站離我家不遠 says how far one place is from another: A 離 B + 遠 / 近 (negated with 不).

pronunciation.note_en: 騎機車 ㄑㄧˊ ㄐㄧ ㄔㄜ puts ㄑ and ㄔ side by side: for 騎 the tongue tip is down behind the lower teeth with the lips spread; for 車 the tip is up just behind the gum ridge. Both have a strong puff of air, and so does 從 ㄘㄨㄥˊ ("ts" plus a puff). In 火車 and 我家 (3 + 1), keep the third tone low (21) with no rise before the high, level first tone.

comprehension.question_en: Why does Ajie say the train is the better choice?
options_en: Train tickets are free at the weekend.
A scooter is slower, and the roads are busy at the weekend.
Mark doesn't know how to ride a scooter.

comprehension.question_en: About how long does the train take from Pingtung to Kaohsiung?
How will Mark get into the station?
options_en: He buys a ticket at the window first.

comprehension.question_en: How can Mark get to Kenting next week?
When and where does the next train to Kaohsiung leave?

speaking.prompt_en: Tell a friend how you usually get to a place you often go (school, work, the market, the station): how you go, how long it takes, how far it is, and why you don't go another way.
speaking.prompt_zh: 跟朋友說說你常常怎麼去一個地方：坐什麼車、要多久、遠不遠，為什麼不用別的方法去。
checklist_en: used 從 A 到 B for the route
used 離 to say how far it is (離 … 很近 / 不遠)
compared two ways with 比 (A 比 B 快 / 慢)
said how long it takes (要 … 分鐘 / 小時, 差不多 …)
kept the third tone low in 火車 and 我家

writing.prompt_en: Write a short message (3-4 sentences) to a friend who is coming to visit: how to get from the station to your home, how long it takes, and which way is faster.
writing.prompt_zh: 寫一個短訊息給要來找你的朋友：從車站怎麼到你家、要多久、哪一個比較快。
writing.model_zh: 我家離車站不遠。從車站到我家，騎機車差不多十分鐘。坐公車比騎機車慢，要二十幾分鐘。到了跟我說，我去接你！

culture_en: Taiwan calls a scooter 機車 (the Mainland word is 摩托車), and in Pingtung it is the everyday way to get around. By law the rider and the passenger must both wear a helmet (安全帽). At many big intersections scooters may not turn left directly: they make a two-stage left turn (兩段式左轉), going straight first, waiting in the marked box, then crossing with the next green light. When you ride Taiwan Railway trains without a reserved seat, you can tap in and out with an EasyCard (悠遊卡) or an iPASS (一卡通, the card from Kaohsiung that is common in the south) instead of buying a ticket. Kenting has no railway, so people get there by intercity bus or by road.
